caption:
Google shut down Q&A on every Business Profile.

Its AI, Ask Maps, now writes the answer on the spot when someone asks about your business. It pulls that answer from your reviews, your photos, and your services section.

Thin profile, thin answer. Here's the fix this week:

1. Open your services section and write real detail for each one, not just a label
2. Add fresh photos this month, Ask Maps reads them
3. Reply to every review with the actual job and result, not just "thanks"

Feed it real material. It answers for you in front of every customer who asks.

DM TOOLS

#GoogleBusinessProfile #LocalSEO #ServiceBusiness #LeadGeneration #SmallBusinessMarketing
rationale: Quick-tutorial to-camera reels win completion right now, and Google's Q&A shutdown plus the new Ask Maps AI answer system is a fresh, verifiable GBP angle turned into a concrete profile-content checklist, distinct from every prior GBP post shipped.
